description: This file implements an in-memory, session-scoped queue system for handling human-readable system events, including functions for enqueuing, draining, peeking, and managing delivery contexts.

methods.name: requireSessionKey
methods.description: Validates and trims the session key, throwing an error if invalid.

methods.name: normalizeContextKey
methods.description: Normalizes a context key by trimming and converting to lowercase.

methods.name: getSessionQueue
methods.description: Retrieves the session queue for a given session key if it exists.

methods.name: getOrCreateSessionQueue
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a session queue for a given session key.

methods.name: cloneSystemEvent
methods.description: Creates a shallow copy of a SystemEvent, including a copy of its deliveryContext if present.
